source.title: Pre-Technical Studies Grade 8 - July 2024 - Revised (KICD Junior School Curriculum Design)
source.notes: WebFetch could not extract text from the PDF ('unable to extract text') but reported the file saved locally; the Read tool then parsed the full PDF text natively, verbatim. Cover page reads 'KENYA INSTITUTE OF CURRICULUM DEVELOPMENT / JUNIOR SCHOOL CURRICULUM DESIGN / PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES / GRADE 8', ISBN 978-9914-43-986-1, first published 2023, revised 2024 -- this matches the confirmed official filename 'Pre-Technical Studies Grade 8 - July 2024 - Revised.pdf' independently verified from KICD's own Google Drive index (file ID 1Cvh2JSBlrHU4z4FKt7uVMgTMXEWq9jdu) on the Grade 8 designs page. All 5 strands and 13 sub-strands below were read verbatim from the 'SUMMARY OF STRANDS AND SUB STRANDS' table (p.xii) and cross-checked against each strand's detailed section (pp.1-31). The document breaks down no further than sub-strand level (no subSubStrands anywhere), same as the Grade 9 Pre-Technical Studies design. Strand 2's summary-table label is just '2.0 Communication' but every detailed body table heading (and the TOC) consistently uses the fuller 'Communication in Pre-Technical Studies' -- the fuller body heading is used here as canonical, following the same precedent set for Grade 9. Content differs substantially from Grade 9 (different sub-strand topics throughout, e.g. Fire Safety/Data Safety instead of Safety on Raised Platforms/Handling Hazardous Substances), confirming Grade 8 is not a re-run of Grade 9 content.

subStrands.name: Fire Safety
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify possible causes of fire outbreaks in the environment
Explain ways of preventing fire outbreaks in the environment
Extinguish fires in the environment using appropriate methods
Acknowledge the need for fire safety in day-to-day life
keyInquiryQuestions: Why is fire safety important?
subStrands.notes: Suggested lessons stated inconsistently as 7 in the summary table but 6 lessons in the detailed section heading. Firefighting techniques named: cooling, smothering, starving, interrupting. Causes named: flammable substances, electrical faults, combustible materials.

subStrands.name: Data Safety
specificLearningOutcomes: Outline the importance of data in an electronic device
Identify threats to data in an electronic device
Describe ways of protecting data in an electronic device
Secure data in an electronic device
Acknowledge the need for data safety in day-to-day life
keyInquiryQuestions: How is data protected in an electronic device?
subStrands.notes: Suggested lessons stated as 11 in the summary table but 4 lessons in the detailed section heading. Threats named: virus, unauthorised access. Protection techniques named: passwords, antivirus scanning.

subStrands.name: Plane Geometry
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify instruments used in drawing
Explain the layout of a drawing environment
Construct combined shapes applied in drawing
Embrace the use of plane geometry in drawing
keyInquiryQuestions: How are combined shapes applied in day-to-day life?
subStrands.notes: Summary table says 4 lessons; detailed section heading says 8 lessons. Instruments named: set squares, drawing set, straight edges, pencils.

subStrands.name: Dimensioning
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify the types of dimensioning in drawing
Draw lines used for dimensioning in drawing
Dimension given shapes in drawings
Embrace the importance of dimensioning in drawing
keyInquiryQuestions: Why is dimensioning applied in drawings?
subStrands.notes: Summary table says 7 lessons; detailed section heading says 10 lessons. Types named: linear, radial, angular, arc. Forms named: parallel, chain, combined.

subStrands.name: Plain Scale Drawing
specificLearningOutcomes: Describe the features of a plain scale used in drawing
Interpret a plain scale used in drawing
Draw plane figures to a given scale
Appreciate the use of plain scale drawing in the work environment
keyInquiryQuestions: What is the importance of drawing figures to scale?
How are plane figures drawn to scale?

subStrands.name: Visual Programming
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify types of visual programming applications used in day-to-day life
Explore the features of visual programming applications in a user environment
Create instructions to solve problems using visual programming application
Value the importance of visual programming in day-to-day life
keyInquiryQuestions: How are computer programs used in day-to-day life?
subStrands.notes: Summary table says 14 lessons; detailed section heading says 13 lessons. Application types named: educational, multimedia, video games. Named examples: Microsoft MakeCode, Scratch, Sprite box. Terminologies covered: syntax, variables, input/output statements, coding, coding blocks, sequence statements, repeating statements, selection statements, variable declarations.

subStrands.name: Composite Materials
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify composite materials in the locality
Describe the composition of composite materials in the locality
Relate composite materials to their use in a work environment
Acknowledge the importance of composite materials used in the locality
keyInquiryQuestions: How can composite materials be identified?
Why are composite materials used in day-to-day life?
subStrands.notes: Example composites named: concrete, bricks, manufactured boards, stone, paper-mache, plastic-coated paper.

subStrands.name: Ceramic Materials
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify common ceramic materials in the locality
Describe the physical properties of ceramic materials in the locality
Relate ceramic materials to their use in a work environment
Acknowledge the importance of ceramic materials used in the locality
keyInquiryQuestions: How are ceramic materials used in day-to-day life?
subStrands.notes: Summary table calls this sub-strand 'Ceramics'; the detailed body section heading calls it 'Ceramic Materials' -- the fuller body heading used here. Example items named: pottery, ceramic utensils, glass, shells. Properties named: brittleness, fire resistance, heat resistance, water resistance, corrosion resistance.

subStrands.name: Cutting Tools
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify cutting tools used in the work environment
Select cutting tools for given tasks in a workplace
Use cutting tools to perform a given task
Care for cutting tools in the work environment
Recognise the importance of cutting tools in the work environment
keyInquiryQuestions: Why are cutting tools cared for?
subStrands.notes: Example tools named: snips, chisels, handsaws, planes, hacksaws, scrappers, knives, strippers, cutters.

subStrands.name: Computer Software
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify the categories of computer software used in a workplace
Explain the functions of different application software in the workplace
Use computer software to perform tasks in day-to-day life
Acknowledge the importance of application software in the workplace
keyInquiryQuestions: How is computer software used in day-to-day life?
Why is computer software important?
subStrands.notes: Summary table says 6 lessons; detailed section heading says 12 lessons. Categories named: system software, application software. Application software types named: word processing, presentation, spreadsheets.

subStrands.name: Bookkeeping
specificLearningOutcomes: Explain the importance of bookkeeping in entrepreneurship
Classify business transactions in bookkeeping
Prepare simple financial statements for a business
Appreciate the importance of financial records in day-to-day life
keyInquiryQuestions: Why is bookkeeping important to a business?
How are the statements of financial position, cash flow and income statement prepared?
subStrands.notes: Financial statements covered: statement of financial position, cash flow statement, income statement. Uses the bookkeeping equation (assets, liabilities, capital).

subStrands.name: Income and Budgeting
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify sources of income for an individual
Explain the importance of budgeting in day-to-day life
Prepare a simple budget for personal financial management
Explore ethical and unethical practices in budgeting
Appreciate the importance of financial planning in income management
keyInquiryQuestions: Why is it important to prepare a personal budget?
What are the ethical issues in income and budgeting?

subStrands.name: Marketing of Goods and Services
specificLearningOutcomes: Explain the importance of marketing to a business
Analyse the sources of information about the market for its potential customers
Explore factors considered when selecting a suitable market for goods and services
Select tools to market goods and services
Recognise suitable markets for goods and services
keyInquiryQuestions: How is the market of goods and services selected?
Where can information about the market and its potential customers be sourced from?
subStrands.notes: Summary table lists this sub-strand as 'Marketing goods and Services'; body section heading uses 'Marketing of Goods and Services' -- fuller body heading used here. Enabling conditions named: type of roads, quality of vehicles, communication networks.

subStrands.name: Distribution of Goods and Services
specificLearningOutcomes: Explain the role of intermediaries in the distribution of goods and services
Illustrate the channels for distributing different goods and services in business
Analyse ethics in distribution of goods and services
Value the need for distribution of goods and services in the community
keyInquiryQuestions: How is the distribution of goods and services carried out in day-to-day life?
Which ethical issues influence distribution of goods and services?
